name: io.theqrcode/qr-code-generator
title: TheQRCode.io
description: Free styled QR codes, no key: URL, WiFi, contact, text, email. API key adds saved codes + analytics.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer <api key>. Without it the session is anonymous: generate_qr_code only, every QR type and every design option, PNG output, 100 req/hr per IP. A Developer ($19/mo) or Pro ($29/mo) key saves codes to the account and unlocks svg/pdf output, at 2,000 MCP requests/hr on Developer or 500/hr on Pro. list_qr_codes and get_analytics require a Developer key.
